blocks.zh: 原物料、生產控制與無菌操作要求（§211.113）
blocks.en: Component Controls, Production Controls and Aseptic Operations (§211.113)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 §§211.80–211.89 原物料管控體系：從收料、檢疫、身份確認、CoA 依賴條件，到核准使用與拒絕程序
blocks.en: Understand the component control system in §§211.80–211.89: from receipt, quarantine and identity testing to the conditions for relying on a CoA, and through to approval for use and rejection procedures

blocks.zh: 理解 §211.94 藥品容器與封蓋要求，連結容器封閉完整性（CCI）和可萃取物/浸出物（E&L）框架
blocks.en: Understand the container and closure requirements of §211.94, and link them to the container closure integrity (CCI) and extractables and leachables (E&L) frameworks

blocks.zh: 熟悉 §§211.100–211.105 書面程序、偏差管理、投料、產率計算與設備標識的實務要求
blocks.en: Become familiar with the practical requirements of §§211.100–211.105 on written procedures, deviation management, charge-in of components, yield calculations and equipment identification

blocks.zh: 深入解析 §211.113——無菌藥品製造的核心法規錨點：非無菌與無菌產品微生物污染控制、無菌製程驗證（培養基灌充模擬）、滅菌驗證（D值、SAL 10⁻⁶）與環境監控義務
blocks.en: Analyze §211.113 in depth as the core regulatory anchor for sterile drug manufacturing: microbiological contamination control for non-sterile and sterile products, aseptic process validation (media fill), sterilization validation (D-value, SAL of 10⁻⁶) and environmental monitoring obligations

blocks.zh: 識別各條款常見 FDA 483 觀察項目與警告信引用模式，建立合規風險意識
blocks.en: Recognize the common FDA 483 observations and Warning Letter citation patterns for each provision, to build compliance risk awareness

blocks.zh: 3.1 §§211.80–211.89 — Component Controls: Receipt, Testing & Approval 3.1 §§211.80–211.89 — 原料管制：收料、檢驗與核准
blocks.en: 3.1 §§211.80–211.89 — Component Controls: Receipt, Testing & Approval

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 原物料管控體系架構 Component Qualification Program
blocks.en: Component Qualification Program

blocks.zh: §§211.80–211.89 建立了一套完整的「原物料生命週期管控」框架，可以理解為六個階段：
blocks.en: §§211.80–211.89 establish a complete "component life cycle control" framework, which can be understood as six stages:

blocks.zh: 收料（Receipt） — 入廠記錄、供應商 CoA 核對
blocks.en: Receipt — incoming records and verification of the supplier CoA

blocks.zh: 檢疫（Quarantine） — 未測試前禁止使用，物理隔離或狀態標示
blocks.en: Quarantine — no use before testing is complete; physical segregation or status labeling

blocks.zh: 取樣與測試（Sampling & Testing） — 依 §211.84(b) 統計取樣原則，進行身份、純度、強度、品質測試
blocks.en: Sampling & Testing — identity, purity, strength and quality testing, using the statistical sampling principles of §211.84(b)

blocks.zh: 核准/拒絕（Approval/Rejection） — QU 決定放行或拒絕
blocks.en: Approval/Rejection — the QU decides on release or rejection

blocks.zh: 儲存管理（Storage / FEFO） — §211.86 先進先出（FEFO）原則
blocks.en: Storage (FEFO) — the first-expired, first-out (FEFO) principle of §211.86

blocks.zh: 再測試（Retesting） — 長期儲存或暴露特殊條件後，§211.87 要求重新確認
blocks.en: Retesting — §211.87 requires re-confirmation after long-term storage or exposure to special conditions

blocks.zh: 任何一個環節的程序缺失都可能成為 483 觀察項目的來源。
blocks.en: A procedural gap at any one of these stages can become the source of a 483 observation.

blocks.zh: CoA 依賴條件詳解 Supplier CoA Reliance: §211.84(c)(2)
blocks.en: Supplier CoA Reliance: §211.84(c)(2)

blocks.zh: 工廠可以「依賴供應商分析報告（Certificate of Analysis, CoA）」代替自行進行全面測試，但必須同時滿足兩個條件：
blocks.en: A site may "rely on the supplier's Certificate of Analysis (CoA)" in place of performing full testing itself, but two conditions must both be met:

blocks.zh: 條件 1（不可豁免）： 廠方仍必須對每個原物料進行至少一項「特定身份測試（specific identity test）」。這是無法委外或豁免的強制要求。對於無菌製造的 API，通常是 IR 光譜比對或 HPLC 鑑別。
blocks.en: Condition 1 (no exemption): The site must still perform at least one "specific identity test" on each component. This is a mandatory requirement that cannot be outsourced or waived. For an API used in sterile manufacturing, this is usually an IR spectrum comparison or HPLC identification.

blocks.zh: 條件 2（驗證義務）： 廠方必須定期驗證供應商測試方法的可靠性（validation of supplier's test methods at appropriate intervals）。這意味著你不能永遠只看 CoA——需要有系統地進行供應商稽核和方法比對驗證。
blocks.en: Condition 2 (validation obligation): The site must validate the reliability of the supplier's test methods at appropriate intervals. This means you cannot rely on the CoA indefinitely; you need systematic supplier audits and method comparison/verification.

blocks.zh: 常見 483 陷阱 Common 483 Pattern
blocks.en: Common 483 Pattern

blocks.zh: 「Failure to conduct at least one specific identity test on each component」 — 即使已有供應商 CoA，若廠方跳過了身份確認測試（例如只查核 CoA 文件而未進行任何實驗室鑑別），FDA 會直接引用 §211.84(c)(1) 開 483。
blocks.en: "Failure to conduct at least one specific identity test on each component" — even when a supplier CoA is available, if the site skips the identity test (for example, it only reviews the CoA document and performs no laboratory identification), FDA will cite §211.84(c)(1) directly in a 483.

blocks.zh: 另一常見模式：依賴供應商 CoA 但從未進行方法驗證比對——這違反了 §211.84(c)(2) 的「可靠性驗證」義務。
blocks.en: Another common pattern: relying on the supplier CoA but never performing a method validation comparison — this violates the "reliability validation" obligation of §211.84(c)(2).

blocks.zh: 每個容器均需身份測試 100% Identity Testing Requirement
blocks.en: 100% Identity Testing Requirement

blocks.zh: §211.84(c)(1) 的「each component」要求是對每個批次（lot），而 §211.84(b) 的取樣計畫決定了從多少個容器（containers）中取樣。
blocks.en: The "each component" requirement of §211.84(c)(1) applies to each lot, while the sampling plan under §211.84(b) determines how many containers are sampled.

blocks.zh: FDA 的解釋立場：對於無菌注射用藥的 API，身份測試必須覆蓋每個入廠批次的所有容器（every container）——不能只測取樣容器而跳過其他容器。這一立場見於 FDA 的 CGMP for Finished Pharmaceuticals CPG Section 430.100（2003）和 FDA EIR 引用模式。
blocks.en: FDA's interpretation: for APIs used in sterile injectable drugs, the identity test must cover every container of each incoming lot; it is not acceptable to test only the sampled containers and skip the others. This position appears in FDA's Compliance Policy Guide (CPG) Section 430.100 on CGMP for Finished Pharmaceuticals (2003) and in FDA EIR citation patterns.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：針對高風險成分（主要 API、無菌原料）建立「逐容器身份確認」程序；對輔料可依風險評估採用統計取樣。
blocks.en: Practical advice: establish a "container-by-container identity confirmation" procedure for high-risk components (principal APIs, sterile raw materials); for excipients, statistical sampling may be used based on risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 拒絕物料的隔離管控 Rejected Material Control
blocks.en: Rejected Material Control

blocks.zh: §211.89 的「quarantine system」要求不僅是貼標籤。FDA 查廠官員會核查：
blocks.en: The "quarantine system" required by §211.89 is more than attaching a label. FDA investigators will check the following:

blocks.zh: 拒絕物料是否有物理隔離（專用區域或上鎖儲存）？
blocks.en: Is rejected material physically segregated (dedicated area or locked storage)?

blocks.zh: ERP/倉儲系統中的狀態封鎖是否有效（防止誤用）？
blocks.en: Is the status block in the ERP/warehouse system effective (to prevent inadvertent use)?

blocks.zh: 後續處理（退供應商、銷毀）是否有書面記錄？
blocks.en: Is the subsequent disposition (return to supplier, destruction) supported by written records?

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一批 API 入廠附有供應商 CoA，QC 部門確認外觀後直接放行使用，未進行 IR 鑑別。這違反了哪條法規？FDA 查廠時如何識別這個問題？
blocks.en: A lot of API arrives with a supplier CoA, and the QC department checks the appearance and releases it for use without performing IR identification. Which regulation does this violate? How would FDA identify this problem during an inspection?

blocks.zh: 公司對某供應商 CoA 依賴已達 3 年，但從未進行方法驗證比對。最近才注意到 §211.84(c)(2) 的要求，應如何補救？
blocks.en: A company has relied on a supplier's CoA for 3 years but has never performed a method validation comparison. It has only just noticed the requirement of §211.84(c)(2). How should it remediate?

blocks.zh: 倉庫空間有限，被拒絕的原物料貼上紅色「REJECTED」標籤後仍與合格物料存放在同一架子上。這是否符合 §211.89？
blocks.en: Warehouse space is limited, so rejected raw materials are labeled with a red "REJECTED" label but remain on the same shelf as approved materials. Does this comply with §211.89?

blocks.zh: 3.2 §211.94 — Drug Product Containers and Closures 3.2 §211.94 — 藥品容器封蓋
blocks.en: 3.2 §211.94 — Drug Product Containers and Closures

blocks.zh: §211.94 的三個核心概念
blocks.en: The Three Core Concepts of §211.94

blocks.zh: §211.94 看似簡短，實際上是整個容器封閉系統（Container Closure System, CCS）合規框架的 CGMP 錨點，涵蓋三個層面：
blocks.en: §211.94 looks short, but it is in fact the CGMP anchor for the entire container closure system (CCS) compliance framework, and it covers three aspects:

blocks.zh: 相容性（Compatibility） — §211.94(a)：容器材料不能與藥品發生反應（reactive）、不能向藥品添加雜質（additive）、不能吸附藥品成分（absorptive）
blocks.en: Compatibility — §211.94(a): container materials must not be reactive with the drug product, additive to it (adding impurities), or absorptive (adsorbing components of the drug product)

blocks.zh: 保護性（Protection） — §211.94(b)：容器必須提供足夠屏障，防止光照、濕氣、氧氣等外部因素造成藥品降解或污染
blocks.en: Protection — §211.94(b): the container must provide an adequate barrier to prevent degradation or contamination of the drug product from external factors such as light, moisture and oxygen

blocks.zh: 清潔與除熱原（Cleanliness & Depyrogenation） — §211.94(c)：無菌製品的容器必須去除熱原性，不只是無菌而已
blocks.en: Cleanliness & Depyrogenation — §211.94(c): containers for sterile products must be depyrogenated, not merely sterile

blocks.zh: 容器封閉完整性（CCI）連結 Container Closure Integrity
blocks.en: Container Closure Integrity

blocks.zh: §211.94(b) 的「adequate protection」要求直接連結到容器封閉完整性測試（Container Closure Integrity Testing, CCIT）框架。
blocks.en: The "adequate protection" requirement of §211.94(b) links directly to the Container Closure Integrity Testing (CCIT) framework.

blocks.zh: USP <1207> 系列（CCIT 的法規參考標準）：
blocks.en: USP <1207> series (the compendial reference standards for CCIT):

blocks.zh: USP <1207>：Package Integrity Evaluation — 總則，CCIT 選擇原則
blocks.en: USP <1207>: Package Integrity Evaluation — general chapter; principles for selecting a CCIT method

blocks.zh: USP <1207.1>：高電壓洩漏檢測（HVLD）——適用於液體無菌製品
blocks.en: USP <1207.1>: High-voltage leak detection (HVLD) — applicable to liquid sterile products

blocks.zh: USP <1207.2>：微生物法、染料浸透法、氦滲漏等確定性/機率性方法比較
blocks.en: USP <1207.2>: Comparison of deterministic and probabilistic methods, such as microbial ingress, dye ingress and helium leak

blocks.zh: USP <1207.3>：密封品質測試，包括螺帽扭力、頂空分析等
blocks.en: USP <1207.3>: Seal quality testing, including cap torque, headspace analysis and others

blocks.zh: FDA 在 2016 年發布的Container Closure Integrity Testing in Lieu of Sterility Testing as a Component of the Stability Protocol for Sterile Products 指南中明確：CCIT 可作為無菌製品穩定性方案中替代無菌測試的方法，但需提供充分的科學依據與方法驗證。
blocks.en: In its 2016 guidance Container Closure Integrity Testing in Lieu of Sterility Testing as a Component of the Stability Protocol for Sterile Products, FDA states clearly that CCIT may replace sterility testing in the stability protocol for sterile products, provided that adequate scientific justification and method validation are available.

blocks.zh: 可萃取物與浸出物（E&L）框架
blocks.en: Extractables and Leachables (E&L) Framework

blocks.zh: §211.94(a) 的「additive」要求是 E&L 研究的法規基礎：
blocks.en: The "additive" requirement of §211.94(a) is the regulatory basis for E&L studies:

blocks.zh: 可萃取物（Extractables）：在極端條件（溶劑、溫度、pH）下從容器材料中可提取的化學物質——代表最壞情況的化學遷移潛力
blocks.en: Extractables: chemical substances that can be extracted from the container material under extreme conditions (solvent, temperature, pH); they represent the worst-case potential for chemical migration

blocks.zh: 浸出物（Leachables）：在實際使用/儲存條件下，從容器材料遷移到藥品中的化學物質——直接影響患者安全的指標
blocks.en: Leachables: chemical substances that migrate from the container material into the drug product under actual use/storage conditions; they are a direct indicator of patient safety impact

blocks.zh: E&L 研究路徑：Extractables 研究 → 毒理學評估（TTC 閾值） → Leachables 監測設計 → 規格制定 → 法規提交（CTD Module 3.2.P.2）。
blocks.en: The E&L study pathway: extractables study → toxicological assessment (TTC threshold) → leachables monitoring design → specification setting → regulatory submission (CTD Module 3.2.P.2).

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶注意事項： 注射用玻璃容器需符合 USP <660>（玻璃類型，Type I/II/III）和 EP 3.2.1。無菌注射液必須使用 Type I 硼矽玻璃，防止鹼性離子析出（glass delamination 問題——見 FDA 2011 年警告信）。
blocks.en: Notes on glass vials: Glass containers for injectables must comply with USP <660> (glass types, Type I/II/III) and EP 3.2.1. Sterile injectable solutions must use Type I borosilicate glass to prevent the release of alkaline ions (the glass delamination problem; see the FDA Warning Letters of 2011).

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器（PFS）的特殊考量
blocks.en: Special Considerations for Prefilled Syringes (PFS)

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器（Prefilled Syringes, PFS）是藥品容器與初級包材的複合系統，§211.94 應與以下標準聯合考量：
blocks.en: Prefilled syringes (PFS) are a combined system of drug container and primary packaging, so §211.94 should be considered together with the following standards:

blocks.zh: ISO 11040 系列：PFS 設計、材料、組件測試（特別是 ISO 11040-4 玻璃注射器規格）
blocks.en: ISO 11040 series: PFS design, materials and component testing (in particular ISO 11040-4 on glass syringe specifications)

blocks.zh: USP <1> 注射液通則：微粒物質、容積準確性
blocks.en: USP <1> Injections general chapter: particulate matter and volume accuracy

blocks.zh: 矽油（Silicone Oil）問題：柱塞墊片的矽油潤滑劑可能成為浸出物，需要進行矽油相容性研究
blocks.en: Silicone oil issue: the silicone oil lubricant on the plunger stopper can become a leachable, so a silicone oil compatibility study is needed

blocks.zh: 鎢針（Tungsten Pin）問題：玻璃注射器成型過程使用鎢針，痕量鎢可能引發蛋白質聚集（蛋白質藥物特殊風險）
blocks.en: Tungsten pin issue: tungsten pins are used in forming glass syringes, and trace tungsten can trigger protein aggregation (a particular risk for protein drugs)
483 Observation Patterns Related to §211.94

blocks.zh: 未建立容器/封蓋的書面規格和測試方法（§211.94(d)）
blocks.en: No written specifications and test methods established for containers/closures (§211.94(d))

blocks.zh: 注射用容器未進行 CCIT 驗證，僅依賴目視檢查
blocks.en: No CCIT validation for injectable containers; reliance on visual inspection only

blocks.zh: E&L 研究缺失或僅有 Extractables 研究而無 Leachables 監測計畫
blocks.en: E&L studies missing, or only an extractables study without a leachables monitoring plan

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶除熱原驗證（乾熱 250°C × 30 min，D-value 驗證）文件不齊
blocks.en: Incomplete documentation of glass vial depyrogenation validation (dry heat 250°C × 30 min, D-value verification)

blocks.zh: 一家公司將注射用製品的容器從 10 mL 西林瓶更換為預填充注射器。從 §211.94 角度，需要進行哪些額外評估？
blocks.en: A company changes the container for an injectable product from a 10 mL vial to a prefilled syringe. From the standpoint of §211.94, what additional assessments are needed?

blocks.zh: USP <1207> 中，確定性方法（deterministic methods）和機率性方法（probabilistic methods）各有哪些？FDA 更偏好哪類方法，原因是什麼？
blocks.en: Under USP <1207>, what are the deterministic methods and the probabilistic methods? Which type does FDA prefer, and why?

blocks.zh: 3.3 §§211.100–211.105 — Written Procedures, Production Records & Equipment Identification 3.3 §§211.100–211.105 — 書面程序、生產紀錄與設備識別
blocks.en: 3.3 §§211.100–211.105 — Written Procedures, Production Records & Equipment Identification

blocks.zh: §211.100 — 偏差管理系統設計 Deviation Management System
blocks.en: §211.100 — Deviation Management System

blocks.zh: §211.100(b) 的「recorded and justified」是整個偏差管理系統的法規依據。一個符合規範的偏差管理系統應涵蓋：
blocks.en: The "recorded and justified" wording of §211.100(b) is the regulatory basis for the entire deviation management system. A compliant deviation management system should cover:

blocks.zh: 即時記錄（Real-time Documentation）：偏差發現當下即記錄，不得事後補寫
blocks.en: Real-time Documentation: record the deviation at the moment it is found; no retrospective write-up

blocks.zh: 分類分級（Classification & Severity Grading）：重大（Critical）/ 主要（Major）/ 次要（Minor）偏差的分級標準和處理路徑
blocks.en: Classification & Severity Grading: grading criteria and handling pathways for Critical / Major / Minor deviations

blocks.zh: 立即措施（Immediate Actions）：偏差對批次的影響評估（隔離、繼續、停止）
blocks.en: Immediate Actions: assessment of the deviation's impact on the batch (isolate, continue, stop)

blocks.zh: 根因分析（Root Cause Analysis）：魚骨圖（Ishikawa）、5-Why、故障樹分析
blocks.en: Root Cause Analysis: fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram, 5-Why, fault tree analysis

blocks.zh: CAPA 計畫（Corrective & Preventive Actions）：CAPA 的合理性、可執行性與時程管控
blocks.en: CAPA Plan (Corrective & Preventive Actions): rationale, feasibility and timeline control of the CAPA

blocks.zh: 批次放行影響（Batch Disposition Impact）：偏差是否影響藥品放行的最終 QP/QU 判斷
blocks.en: Batch Disposition Impact: whether the deviation affects the final QP/QU decision on product release

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析（Trend Analysis）：重複性偏差的系統性識別和周期性審核
blocks.en: Trend Analysis: systematic identification of recurring deviations and periodic review

blocks.zh: 參考文件：FDA Process Inspection Guidance 7356.002A（Guide to Inspections of Oral Solid Dosage Forms，2003）和 ICH Q10 第 3.2.3 節（偏差調查）提供了 FDA 對偏差管理的期望框架。
blocks.en: Reference documents: FDA Process Inspection Guidance 7356.002A (Guide to Inspections of Oral Solid Dosage Forms, 2003) and Section 3.2.3 of ICH Q10 (deviation investigation) set out FDA's expected framework for deviation management.

blocks.zh: §211.103 產率計算的重要性 Yield Reconciliation
blocks.en: §211.103 Yield Reconciliation

blocks.zh: 產率計算（Yield Reconciliation）不只是數學運算，它是藥品完整性的間接驗證指標。異常的產率偏差可能提示：
blocks.en: Yield reconciliation is more than arithmetic; it is an indirect verification indicator of product integrity. An abnormal yield deviation may point to:

blocks.zh: 無菌製程中的取樣量超出 SOP 規定（影響收率）
blocks.en: Sampling volumes in the aseptic process exceeding what the SOP specifies (affecting yield)

blocks.zh: 灌裝線上的物料損耗異常（可能提示設備問題或資料完整性問題）
blocks.en: Abnormal material loss on the filling line (which may indicate an equipment problem or a data integrity problem)

blocks.zh: 正在進行的偷竊或藥品轉移（資料完整性紅旗）
blocks.en: Ongoing theft or diversion of drug product (a data integrity red flag)

blocks.zh: §211.103 要求「one person calculates, second person independently verifies」——這是四眼原則（Four-Eyes Principle） 的法規化。對電子批次記錄（eBR）而言，這個驗證步驟必須體現在系統的電子簽名工作流程中。
blocks.en: §211.103 requires that "one person calculates, second person independently verifies". This is the regulatory codification of the Four-Eyes Principle. For an electronic batch record (eBR), this verification step must be built into the system's electronic signature workflow.

blocks.zh: §211.105 設備標識系統 Equipment Status Labeling
blocks.en: §211.105 Equipment Status Labeling

blocks.zh: 無菌製造設施中，設備狀態標識系統通常包含四種狀態（各設施可能有差異，但應覆蓋以下狀態）：
blocks.en: In a sterile manufacturing facility, an equipment status labeling system usually includes four statuses (details may differ between facilities, but these statuses should be covered):

blocks.zh: CLEAN / 已清潔（綠色）：清潔驗證完成，已確認符合清潔規格，可用於生產
blocks.en: CLEAN (green): cleaning validation complete, confirmed to meet the cleaning specification, available for production

blocks.zh: IN USE / 使用中（藍色/黃色）：正在進行生產批次，標示批次號、產品名
blocks.en: IN USE (blue/yellow): a production batch is in progress; batch number and product name are displayed

blocks.zh: DIRTY / 待清潔（紅色）：生產結束，待清潔，禁止啟用
blocks.en: DIRTY (red): production has ended and the equipment awaits cleaning; must not be started up

blocks.zh: OUT OF SERVICE / 停用（紅色）：維修中或待驗證，禁止使用
blocks.en: OUT OF SERVICE (red): under maintenance or awaiting validation; must not be used

blocks.zh: §211.105(b) 要求在批次記錄中記錄使用的「distinctive identification number」，這是追溯（traceability）和偏差調查的關鍵。
blocks.en: §211.105(b) requires that the "distinctive identification number" of the equipment used be recorded in the batch record; this is key to traceability and deviation investigation.

blocks.zh: 一位操作員在灌裝過程中發現環境監控警戒限超標，但因為在班末才填寫批次記錄，偏差記錄是事後 4 小時補寫的。這違反了哪條要求？如何補救？
blocks.en: During filling, an operator finds that an environmental monitoring alert limit has been exceeded, but because the batch record is only completed at the end of the shift, the deviation record is written up retrospectively 4 hours later. Which requirement does this violate? How should it be remediated?

blocks.zh: 如果一批無菌注射液的理論產率計算結果是 96%，但實際計算後得出 78%，QU 應採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: If the theoretical yield calculation for a batch of sterile injectable solution comes out at 96%, but the actual calculation gives 78%, what steps should the QU take?

blocks.zh: 如何撰寫合格的偏差報告 How to Write a Deviation Report
blocks.en: How to Write a Deviation Report

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員評估偏差報告的標準包括：
blocks.en: The criteria FDA investigators use to evaluate a deviation report include:

blocks.zh: 3.4 §§211.110–211.115 — In-Process Controls, Time Limits & Sterile Manufacturing 3.4 §§211.110–211.115 — 製程中管制、時間限制與無菌製造
blocks.en: 3.4 §§211.110–211.115 — In-Process Controls, Time Limits & Sterile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: §211.110 — 中間控制的策略設計 In-Process Control Strategy
blocks.en: §211.110 — In-Process Control Strategy

blocks.zh: §211.110 要求的 IPC（In-Process Controls）不是簡單的檢查點，而是製程驗證（Process Validation）三個階段的橋樑：
blocks.en: The IPC (in-process controls) required by §211.110 are not simple checkpoints; they are the bridge across the three stages of process validation:

blocks.zh: Stage 1 — Process Design： 在開發階段確定哪些製程參數是關鍵質量屬性（CQA）和關鍵製程參數（CPP）
blocks.en: Stage 1 — Process Design: during development, determine which process parameters are critical quality attributes (CQAs) and critical process parameters (CPPs)

blocks.zh: Stage 2 — Process Qualification： 驗證 IPC 策略能有效監控製程輸出的一致性
blocks.en: Stage 2 — Process Qualification: verify that the IPC strategy can effectively monitor the consistency of process output

blocks.zh: Stage 3 — Continued Process Verification： 商業生產中持續監控 IPC 數據，統計製程控制（SPC）分析趨勢
blocks.en: Stage 3 — Continued Process Verification: continuously monitor IPC data in commercial production and analyze trends using statistical process control (SPC)

blocks.zh: 對無菌製品：IPC 包括灌裝重量檢查、粒子計數（灌裝過程中）、環境監控、操作員微生物採樣。§211.110(b) 的「valid statistical sampling plans」要求提示應使用 AQL（Acceptable Quality Level）計畫或等效統計方法。
blocks.en: For sterile products, IPCs include fill weight checks, particle counts (during filling), environmental monitoring and operator microbiological sampling. The "valid statistical sampling plans" requirement of §211.110(b) implies that an AQL (Acceptable Quality Level) plan or an equivalent statistical method should be used.

blocks.zh: §211.113 — 無菌藥品製造的核心法規錨點
blocks.en: §211.113 — The Core Regulatory Anchor for Sterile Drug Manufacturing

blocks.zh: §211.113 是整部 21 CFR Part 211 中對無菌藥品製造商最重要的單一條款。它只有兩句話，但每一個字都有法規分量。理解這一條款需要從以下維度深入解析。
blocks.en: §211.113 is the single most important provision for sterile drug manufacturers in all of 21 CFR Part 211. It has only two sentences, but every word carries regulatory weight. Understanding this provision requires analysis along the following dimensions.

blocks.zh: §211.113(a) vs §211.113(b) — 非無菌 vs 無菌產品的不同義務
blocks.en: §211.113(a) vs §211.113(b) — Different Obligations for Non-Sterile and Sterile Products

blocks.zh: §211.113 分為兩個層次：
blocks.en: §211.113 has two tiers:

blocks.zh: §211.113(a) — 非無菌藥品的微生物控制：
blocks.en: §211.113(a) — Microbiological control of non-sterile drug products:

blocks.zh: 要求建立書面程序，防止「不良微生物（objectionable microorganisms）」出現在藥品中。注意這裡的措辭不是「所有微生物」，而是「objectionable」——意味著非無菌口服製劑不需要達到無菌標準，但不能含有對特定劑型有風險的微生物（例如口服液中的沙門氏菌、金黃色葡萄球菌，眼用製劑中的銅綠假單胞菌）。
blocks.en: It requires written procedures to prevent "objectionable microorganisms" in drug products. Note that the wording is not "all microorganisms" but "objectionable", meaning that non-sterile oral dosage forms need not meet a sterility standard but must not contain microorganisms that pose a risk for the particular dosage form (for example, Salmonella and Staphylococcus aureus in oral liquids, or Pseudomonas aeruginosa in ophthalmic preparations).

blocks.zh: 實務要點：需建立「生物負荷（Bioburden）」規格和測試程序；針對不同劑型定義「objectionable」的標準（參考 USP <1111> 微生物質量屬性指導）。
blocks.en: Practical points: establish bioburden specifications and test procedures; define the "objectionable" criteria for each dosage form (see the guidance on microbiological quality attributes in USP <1111>).

blocks.zh: §211.113(b) — 無菌藥品的微生物控制：
blocks.en: §211.113(b) — Microbiological control of sterile drug products:

blocks.zh: 要求建立書面程序，防止任何微生物污染（不再是「objectionable」，而是全面防止）。最關鍵的附加義務：「Such procedures shall include validation of any sterilization process.」
blocks.en: It requires written procedures to prevent any microbial contamination (no longer "objectionable" only, but comprehensive prevention). The most critical additional obligation: "Such procedures shall include validation of any sterilization process."

blocks.zh: 這一句話將「無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）」從概念義務轉化為具體的驗證法規義務，確立了以下核心要求：
blocks.en: This one sentence turns "sterility assurance" from a conceptual obligation into a concrete regulatory obligation to validate, and establishes the following core requirements:

blocks.zh: 任何滅菌製程（蒸汽、乾熱、輻射、氣體、過濾）都必須經過驗證
blocks.en: Any sterilization process (steam, dry heat, radiation, gas, filtration) must be validated

blocks.zh: 無菌製程（Aseptic Processing）必須透過模擬驗證（Media Fill / Process Simulation）證明其控制微生物污染的能力
blocks.en: Aseptic processing must demonstrate, through simulation (media fill / process simulation), its ability to control microbial contamination

blocks.zh: 環境監控（Environmental Monitoring, EM）計畫必須能有效監測製程的微生物控制狀態
blocks.en: The environmental monitoring (EM) program must be able to effectively monitor the microbiological control status of the process

blocks.zh: 滅菌驗證基礎：D值、Z值與 SAL 10⁻⁶
blocks.en: Sterilization Validation Basics: D-value, Z-value and SAL of 10⁻⁶

blocks.zh: 要理解為什麼滅菌驗證（Sterilization Validation）是科學性義務，需要掌握以下核心微生物動力學概念：
blocks.en: To understand why sterilization validation is a scientific obligation, you need to grasp the following core microbial kinetics concepts:

blocks.zh: D 值（Decimal Reduction Value）：
blocks.en: D-value (Decimal Reduction Value):

blocks.zh: 在特定條件下（特定溫度、輻射劑量等），將特定微生物菌落數降低 90%（1 個 log 數量級）所需的時間或劑量。D 值是微生物對特定滅菌條件抵抗力的量化指標。
blocks.en: The time or dose required, under specified conditions (specific temperature, radiation dose, etc.), to reduce a specific microbial population by 90% (one log order of magnitude). The D-value is a quantitative indicator of a microorganism's resistance to specific sterilization conditions.

blocks.zh: 例：121°C 下，耐熱嗜熱脂肪芽孢桿菌（Geobacillus stearothermophilus，高壓蒸汽滅菌的生物指示劑）的 D 值約為 1.5–2.5 分鐘。若初始生物負荷為 10⁶ CFU，要達到 SAL 10⁻⁶，需要降低 12 個 log，即需要 12D 的處理時間。
blocks.en: Example: at 121°C, the D-value of the heat-resistant Geobacillus stearothermophilus (the biological indicator for steam sterilization) is about 1.5–2.5 minutes. With an initial bioburden of 10⁶ CFU, reaching an SAL of 10⁻⁶ requires a 12-log reduction, i.e. a treatment time of 12D.

blocks.zh: Z 值（Temperature Coefficient）：
blocks.en: Z-value (Temperature Coefficient):

blocks.zh: 溫度升高多少攝氏度，D 值減少 90%（即 D 值改變 1 個 log）所需的溫度差。Z 值描述微生物對溫度變化的敏感性，用於計算不同溫度下的滅菌等效性（F₀ 值）。
blocks.en: The temperature change (in degrees Celsius) required to reduce the D-value by 90% (i.e. to change the D-value by one log). The Z-value describes the sensitivity of a microorganism to temperature change and is used to calculate sterilization equivalence at different temperatures (the F₀ value).

blocks.zh: F₀ 值（Lethality Value）：
blocks.en: F₀ value (Lethality Value):

blocks.zh: 以 121°C、Z = 10°C 為基準，將不同溫度-時間組合的滅菌效力換算成等效的 121°C 滅菌分鐘數。
blocks.en: Taking 121°C and Z = 10°C as the reference, the sterilization effectiveness of different temperature-time combinations is converted to the equivalent minutes at 121°C.
Formula: F₀ = ∫ 10^((T-121)/10) dt

blocks.zh: FDA 通常期望終端滅菌的最小 F₀ ≥ 8 分鐘（相當於對 D₁₂₁ = 1 min 的芽孢提供 8 log 降低），但具體要求應基於產品的生物負荷數據。
blocks.en: FDA generally expects a minimum F₀ of ≥ 8 minutes for terminal sterilization (equivalent to an 8-log reduction of spores with D₁₂₁ = 1 min), but the specific requirement should be based on the product's bioburden data.

blocks.zh: 無菌保證水準（SAL） 是滅菌後容器中存留活微生物的最大概率。FDA 和各主要藥典要求注射用無菌製品達到 SAL ≤ 10⁻⁶，即每一百萬個容器中最多只允許一個容器含有活微生物。
blocks.en: Sterility Assurance Level (SAL) is the maximum probability of a viable microorganism remaining in a container after sterilization. FDA and the major pharmacopoeias require sterile injectable products to achieve an SAL ≤ 10⁻⁶, i.e. no more than one container in a million may contain a viable microorganism.

blocks.zh: 培養基灌充模擬（Media Fill / Process Simulation）深度解析
blocks.en: Media Fill / Process Simulation in Depth

blocks.zh: 培養基灌充試驗（Media Fill Test） 是評估無菌加工能力最重要的驗證工具，也是 §211.113(b)「validate any sterilization process」義務在無菌加工場景下的具體體現。
blocks.en: The Media Fill Test is the most important validation tool for assessing aseptic processing capability, and it is the concrete expression of the §211.113(b) obligation to "validate any sterilization process" in the aseptic processing context.

blocks.zh: 培養基選擇：
blocks.en: Media selection:

blocks.zh: 大豆酪蛋白消化液培養基（TSBA, Tryptic Soy Broth）：最常用，廣譜微生物生長支持，適合評估操作過程中的微生物污染控制
blocks.en: Tryptic Soy Broth (TSB): the most commonly used; supports broad-spectrum microbial growth and is suitable for assessing control of microbial contamination during operations

blocks.zh: 需通過促生長試驗（Growth Promotion Test, GPT）驗證培養基的微生物生長支持能力
blocks.en: The medium must pass a growth promotion test (GPT) to verify its ability to support microbial growth

blocks.zh: 模擬設計原則（Worst-Case Simulation）：
blocks.en: Simulation design principle (Worst-Case Simulation):

blocks.zh: 培養基灌充必須模擬商業生產中的「最壞情況」，包括：
blocks.en: The media fill must simulate the "worst case" of commercial production, including:

blocks.zh: 最大介入（Maximum Interventions）：模擬生產中可能發生的所有操作介入（換針頭、處理卡瓶、人員進出隔離裝置）
blocks.en: Maximum Interventions: simulate all the operational interventions that may occur in production (changing needles, clearing jammed vials, personnel entering and leaving the isolator)

blocks.zh: 最長暴露時間（Maximum Exposure Duration）：使用允許最長生產時間（連接 §211.111 時間限制）
blocks.en: Maximum Exposure Duration: use the longest permitted production time (linked to the time limits of §211.111)

blocks.zh: 最大批次規模（Maximum Batch Size）：覆蓋商業批次規模
blocks.en: Maximum Batch Size: cover the commercial batch size

blocks.zh: 所有班次（All Shifts）：驗證不同班次操作員的一致性
blocks.en: All Shifts: verify consistency across operators on different shifts

blocks.zh: 所有灌裝線（All Fill Lines）：每條生產線需獨立驗證
blocks.en: All Fill Lines: each production line must be validated independently

blocks.zh: 合格標準（Acceptance Criteria）：
blocks.en: Acceptance Criteria:

blocks.zh: FDA 2004 無菌加工指南的明確期望：
blocks.en: The explicit expectations of the FDA 2004 aseptic processing guidance:

blocks.zh: 灌充容器數 <5,000：零污染（0 個陽性容器）
blocks.en: Containers filled <5,000: zero contamination (0 positive containers)
Containers filled 5,000–10,000:

blocks.zh: 1 個陽性容器 → 調查 + 考慮重新驗證
blocks.en: 1 positive container → investigation + consider revalidation

blocks.zh: 2 個或以上陽性容器 → 調查 + 重新驗證（失敗）
blocks.en: 2 or more positive containers → investigation + revalidation (failure)

blocks.zh: 灌充容器數 >10,000：污染率 <0.1%（即每 10,000 個容器不超過 10 個陽性）
blocks.en: Containers filled >10,000: contamination rate <0.1% (i.e. no more than 10 positives per 10,000 containers)

blocks.zh: 注意：任何培養基灌充失敗都需要進行全面根因調查，包括回顧批次記錄、EM 趨勢、操作員行為記錄、設備維護記錄等。
blocks.en: Note: any media fill failure requires a comprehensive root cause investigation, including review of batch records, EM trends, operator behavior records, equipment maintenance records, etc.

blocks.zh: 驗證頻率：
blocks.en: Validation frequency:

blocks.zh: 初始驗證： 三次連續成功的培養基灌充試驗（三批次確認）
blocks.en: Initial validation: three consecutive successful media fill runs (three-batch confirmation)

blocks.zh: 定期再確認： 每 6 個月一次（每條線、每班次）——FDA 2004 指南的明確期望
blocks.en: Periodic requalification: every 6 months (each line, each shift), an explicit expectation of the FDA 2004 guidance

blocks.zh: 事件觸發再驗證： 設備重大修改、設施翻新、無菌操作 SOP 變更、EM 趨勢惡化後
blocks.en: Event-triggered revalidation: after major equipment modifications, facility renovation, changes to aseptic operation SOPs, or deteriorating EM trends

blocks.zh: §211.113 與 FDA 無菌加工指南（2004）的關係
blocks.en: §211.113 and the FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004)

blocks.zh: FDA 2004 年發布的Guidance for Industry: Sterile Drug Products Produced by Aseptic Processing — Current Good Manufacturing Practice（通稱「FDA 無菌加工指南」）是 §211.113(b) 的詳細詮釋文件。雖然指南本身不具法規強制力，但 FDA 在查廠時實際上按照指南的標準評估合規性。
blocks.en: The Guidance for Industry: Sterile Drug Products Produced by Aseptic Processing — Current Good Manufacturing Practice issued by FDA in 2004 (commonly called the "FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance") is the detailed interpretive document for §211.113(b). Although the guidance itself is not legally binding, FDA in practice evaluates compliance against its standards during inspections.

blocks.zh: 指南涵蓋的主要領域：
blocks.en: The main areas covered by the guidance:

blocks.zh: 廠房設計（建築材料、氣流設計、氣壓梯度、HVAC）
blocks.en: Facility design (construction materials, airflow design, pressure differentials, HVAC)

blocks.zh: 設備（隔離技術 RABS/Isolator、凍乾機無菌密封、填充設備設計）
blocks.en: Equipment (barrier technologies such as RABS/isolator, aseptic sealing of lyophilizers, filling equipment design)

blocks.zh: 人員（更衣程序、人員監控、人員介入管理）
blocks.en: Personnel (gowning procedures, personnel monitoring, management of personnel interventions)

blocks.zh: 生產（組件準備、過濾滅菌、灌填封裝）
blocks.en: Production (component preparation, sterilizing filtration, filling and closing)

blocks.zh: 無菌製程模擬（媒體灌充設計、合格標準）
blocks.en: Aseptic process simulation (media fill design, acceptance criteria)

blocks.zh: 微生物監控（EM 計畫設計）
blocks.en: Microbiological monitoring (EM program design)

blocks.zh: 實驗室控制（無菌測試、內毒素測試）
blocks.en: Laboratory controls (sterility testing, endotoxin testing)

blocks.zh: 對無菌製造從業者而言，熟讀 FDA 無菌加工指南（2004）與 §211.113(b) 一起閱讀，才能完整理解 CGMP 義務的全貌。
blocks.en: For sterile manufacturing practitioners, the FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004) must be read together with §211.113(b) to fully understand the whole picture of CGMP obligations.

blocks.zh: §211.113 與 PIC/S Annex 1（2022）的交叉解讀
blocks.en: Reading §211.113 Together with PIC/S Annex 1 (2022)

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1（2022 更新版，同時也是 EU Annex 1）是迄今最詳細的無菌製藥製造指南，從污染控制策略（CCS）的整體視角建構了比 §211.113 更詳盡的要求框架：
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 (the 2022 revision, which is also EU Annex 1) is the most detailed guidance on sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing to date, and builds from the overall perspective of the contamination control strategy (CCS) a framework of requirements more detailed than §211.113:

blocks.zh: 污染控制策略（Contamination Control Strategy, CCS）：新增概念，要求建立整廠污染控制的書面策略，覆蓋建築環境、人員、材料、設備、製程的整體風險評估
blocks.en: Contamination Control Strategy (CCS): a new concept requiring a written site-wide contamination control strategy, covering an overall risk assessment of the building environment, personnel, materials, equipment and process

blocks.zh: 隔離技術（Barrier Technologies）：RABS（限制進入屏障系統）和隔離器（Isolator）的詳細要求；Annex 1 鼓勵使用隔離器以提高無菌保證
blocks.en: Barrier Technologies: detailed requirements for RABS (restricted access barrier systems) and isolators; Annex 1 encourages the use of isolators to improve sterility assurance

blocks.zh: 即時 EM（Real-time EM）：強調在灌裝過程中的連續粒子監測
blocks.en: Real-time EM: emphasizes continuous particle monitoring during filling

blocks.zh: 參數放行（Parametric Release）：終端滅菌產品的參數放行（以物理/化學數據替代無菌測試放行）的條件和要求
blocks.en: Parametric Release: the conditions and requirements for parametric release of terminally sterilized products (release on physical/chemical data in place of sterility testing)

blocks.zh: §211.113 提供了法規義務的「底線」，而 PIC/S Annex 1 / FDA 2004 指南提供了達到底線的「科學方法路徑圖」。對於尋求全球市場准入的製造商，必須同時符合兩個框架。
blocks.en: §211.113 provides the "floor" of regulatory obligation, while PIC/S Annex 1 and the FDA 2004 guidance provide the "scientific roadmap" for reaching that floor. Manufacturers seeking access to global markets must comply with both frameworks.

blocks.zh: §211.113 相關 FDA 483 與警告信模式
blocks.en: FDA 483 and Warning Letter Patterns Related to §211.113

blocks.zh: 以下為 FDA 公開 483 觀察項目和警告信中最常見的 §211.113 引用模式（按頻率排序）：
blocks.en: The following are the most common §211.113 citation patterns in publicly available FDA 483 observations and Warning Letters (in order of frequency):

blocks.zh:
「Failure to validate aseptic processing operations」（最常見）
具體表現：培養基灌充試驗失敗後未進行全面根因調查；或初始驗證不充分（未覆蓋所有班次、所有介入類型）
blocks.en:
"Failure to validate aseptic processing operations" (most common)
Typical findings: no comprehensive root cause investigation after a media fill failure; or inadequate initial validation (not covering all shifts and all intervention types)

blocks.zh:
「Inadequate environmental monitoring program」
具體表現：取樣點位未覆蓋關鍵操作區域；警戒限/行動限設置缺乏科學依據；EM 超標後調查不充分
blocks.en:
"Inadequate environmental monitoring program"
Typical findings: sampling locations do not cover critical operating areas; alert/action limits lack scientific justification; inadequate investigation after EM excursions

blocks.zh:
「Failure to validate sterilization process」
具體表現：F₀ 計算錯誤；生物指示劑使用不當；高壓蒸汽滅菌驗證未覆蓋最難滅菌位置（cold spot）
blocks.en:
"Failure to validate sterilization process"
Typical findings: errors in F₀ calculation; improper use of biological indicators; steam sterilization validation that does not cover the most difficult-to-sterilize location (cold spot)

blocks.zh:
「Inadequate written procedures for preventing microbiological contamination」
具體表現：EM 計畫 SOP 缺失；無菌技術 SOP 不涵蓋異常情況處理；更衣程序未文件化
blocks.en:
"Inadequate written procedures for preventing microbiological contamination"
Typical findings: no EM program SOP; aseptic technique SOP that does not address handling of abnormal situations; gowning procedures not documented

blocks.zh:
「Failure to conduct adequate investigation of sterility test failures」
具體表現：無菌測試陽性（TST failure）後根因調查不充分，缺乏對同期生產批次的充分評估
blocks.en:
"Failure to conduct adequate investigation of sterility test failures"
Typical findings: inadequate root cause investigation after a positive sterility test (TST failure), with insufficient assessment of batches produced during the same period

blocks.zh: §211.115 再加工（Reprocessing）的無菌製品應用
blocks.en: §211.115 Reprocessing of Sterile Products

blocks.zh: §211.115 要求書面再加工程序，但對無菌製品而言，再加工的空間極為有限：
blocks.en: §211.115 requires written reprocessing procedures, but for sterile products the scope for reprocessing is extremely limited:

blocks.zh: 允許的再加工情況： 某些中間體（如未灌裝的藥液）在特定條件下可再加工（例如：過濾失敗後重新過濾，前提是生物負荷仍在控制範圍且時間限制未超出）
blocks.en: Permitted reprocessing: certain intermediates (such as unfilled bulk solution) may be reprocessed under specific conditions (for example, refiltration after a filtration failure, provided that the bioburden remains within control limits and time limits have not been exceeded)

blocks.zh: 通常不允許的再加工： 已灌裝容器的無菌測試失敗批次、EM 超標批次通常不能再加工（而是拒絕）
blocks.en: Generally not permitted: batches with filled containers that failed sterility testing, or batches with EM excursions, normally cannot be reprocessed (they are rejected instead)

blocks.zh: 再加工驗證： 若公司計畫允許再加工，必須有驗證數據支持再加工對產品品質（特別是微生物安全性）沒有負面影響
blocks.en: Reprocessing validation: if a company plans to allow reprocessing, it must have validation data demonstrating that reprocessing has no adverse effect on product quality (especially microbiological safety)

blocks.zh: QU 的再加工批准（§211.115(b)）對無菌製品而言必須特別謹慎，因為無菌產品的再加工失敗可能直接威脅患者安全（靜脈注射給藥途徑無法透過人體防線過濾掉污染）。
blocks.en: QU approval of reprocessing (§211.115(b)) must be handled with particular care for sterile products, because a reprocessing failure with a sterile product can directly threaten patient safety (with intravenous administration, the body's natural defenses cannot filter out contamination).

blocks.zh: 綜合練習思考 Comprehensive Practice Questions
blocks.en: Comprehensive Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家製造商在一次培養基灌充試驗中出現 2 個陽性容器（共灌充 6,800 個容器）。調查發現可能是某操作員的無菌技術問題。FDA 查廠官員發現調查僅針對那位操作員進行了再培訓，並未評估同期生產的商業批次。從 §211.113(b) 角度，哪些調查步驟被遺漏了？
blocks.en: A manufacturer has 2 positive containers in a media fill run (6,800 containers filled in total). The investigation concludes that the cause may be one operator's aseptic technique. FDA investigators find that the investigation only retrained that operator and did not assess the commercial batches produced during the same period. From the standpoint of §211.113(b), which investigation steps were missed?

blocks.zh: 一家無菌製造商決定對某注射液從高壓蒸汽終端滅菌改為無菌加工，原因是客戶要求更改配方加入一種熱不穩定輔料。這個決策在法規上需要做什麼？FDA 的立場是什麼？
blocks.en: A sterile manufacturer decides to change an injectable product from autoclave terminal sterilization to aseptic processing, because the customer has requested a formulation change that adds a heat-labile excipient. What does this decision require from a regulatory standpoint? What is FDA's position?

blocks.zh: §211.113(b) 規定「validation of any sterilization process」，對一條新建的隔離器灌裝線（使用汽化過氧化氫 VHP 去污），需要驗證哪些製程？各自的驗證關鍵參數是什麼？
blocks.en: §211.113(b) specifies "validation of any sterilization process". For a newly built isolator filling line (decontaminated with vaporized hydrogen peroxide, VHP), which processes need to be validated? What are the key validation parameters of each?

blocks.zh: EM 顯示 ISO 5 區（Grade A）一個月內出現 3 次警戒限超標，但未達行動限。QA 部門認為由於未超行動限，不需要進一步調查。這個判斷是否正確？從 §211.113(b) 和 FDA 指南角度如何評估？
blocks.en: EM shows three alert level excursions in one month in the ISO 5 area (Grade A), but the action limit was not reached. The QA department considers that because the action limit was not exceeded, no further investigation is needed. Is this judgment correct? How should it be assessed from the standpoint of §211.113(b) and the FDA guidance?

blocks.zh: 解釋為什麼「SAL 10⁻⁶」在終端滅菌和無菌加工中的意義是不同的。
blocks.en: Explain why "SAL of 10⁻⁶" means different things for terminal sterilization and for aseptic processing.

blocks.zh: §211.111 — 時間限制的無菌製造意義 Time Limits in Sterile Operations
blocks.en: §211.111 — Time Limits in Sterile Operations

blocks.zh: 時間限制在無菌製造中比一般劑型更具關鍵性，因為與微生物增殖直接相關：
blocks.en: Time limits are more critical in sterile manufacturing than for other dosage forms, because they are directly related to microbial proliferation:

blocks.zh: 偏差處理：§211.111 明確允許時間偏差，但必須「justified and documented」——不能僅憑操作員判斷，需要 QA 評估和書面記錄。
blocks.en: Deviations from time limits: §211.111 expressly allows time deviations, but they must be "justified and documented"; they cannot rest on the operator's judgment alone and require QA assessment and written records.

blocks.zh: 滅菌方法選擇層級 Sterilization Method Hierarchy
blocks.en: Sterilization Method Hierarchy

blocks.zh: FDA 的立場（明確見於 2004 年 FDA 無菌加工指南 Appendix 1 和 FDA PQLI 報告）：終端滅菌（Terminal Sterilization）優先於無菌加工（Aseptic Processing）。
blocks.en: FDA's position (stated explicitly in Appendix 1 of the 2004 FDA aseptic processing guidance and in the FDA PQLI report): terminal sterilization is preferred over aseptic processing.

blocks.zh: FDA 之所以偏好終端滅菌，是因為無菌加工本質上是「機率性」而非「絕對性」的無菌保證——培養基灌充試驗（Media Fill）的失敗率目標通常為 <0.1%（每 10,000 個模擬容器不超過 1 個污染）。
blocks.en: FDA prefers terminal sterilization because aseptic processing is by nature a "probabilistic" rather than "absolute" assurance of sterility; the target failure rate for a media fill is usually <0.1% (no more than 1 contaminated unit per 10,000 simulated containers).

blocks.zh: 環境監控計畫（Environmental Monitoring, EM）與 §211.113
blocks.en: Environmental Monitoring (EM) Program and §211.113

blocks.zh: §211.113(b) 的「procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination」義務隱含了一個必要前提：必須有監控系統來確認這些程序的有效性。這就是 EM 計畫的法規依據。
blocks.en: The obligation in §211.113(b) for "procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination" implies a necessary precondition: there must be a monitoring system to confirm the effectiveness of those procedures. This is the regulatory basis for the EM program.

blocks.zh: EM 計畫的四個組成部分：
blocks.en: The four components of an EM program:

blocks.zh: 取樣位置（Sampling Locations）：依風險分級（ISO 5/Grade A 關鍵區域 → ISO 7/Grade B 背景 → ISO 8/Grade C/D 支持區域），定義取樣點位及其科學依據
blocks.en: Sampling Locations: graded by risk (ISO 5/Grade A critical zone → ISO 7/Grade B background → ISO 8/Grade C/D support areas), with sampling points and their scientific justification defined

blocks.zh: 取樣方法（Sampling Methods）：沉降碟（Settle Plates，被動取樣）、接觸碟（Contact / RODAC plates，表面取樣）、主動空氣取樣（RCS、SAS 等儀器取樣）；人員監控（手套指印、更衣服取樣）
blocks.en: Sampling Methods: settle plates (passive sampling), contact/RODAC plates (surface sampling), active air sampling (instruments such as RCS and SAS); personnel monitoring (glove fingerprints, gown sampling)

blocks.zh: 警戒限與行動限（Alert Levels & Action Levels）：警戒限（Alert Level）超標觸發趨勢調查；行動限（Action Level）超標觸發 CAPA 並評估批次影響
blocks.en: Alert Levels & Action Levels: an Alert Level excursion triggers a trend investigation; an Action Level excursion triggers a CAPA and an assessment of batch impact

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析（Trend Analysis）：周期性分析 EM 數據趨勢，識別早期惡化信號（Excursion trending）
blocks.en: Trend Analysis: periodic analysis of EM data trends to identify early signs of deterioration (excursion trending)

blocks.zh: ISO 14644 潔淨室等級與 EU Annex 1（2022）/FDA 2004 指南的對應：
blocks.en: Correspondence between ISO 14644 cleanroom classes and EU Annex 1 (2022)/the FDA 2004 guidance:

blocks.zh: 注意：FDA 2004 無菌加工指南與 EU Annex 1（2022 更新版）的分類體系略有差異，對出口歐盟市場的製造商，需同時符合兩套標準。PIC/S Annex 1（2022）已與 EU Annex 1 高度一致。
blocks.en: Note: the classification systems of the FDA 2004 aseptic processing guidance and EU Annex 1 (2022 revision) differ slightly, so manufacturers exporting to the EU market must comply with both sets of standards. PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) is now highly aligned with EU Annex 1.

blocks.zh: EM 結果的批次放行影響：
blocks.en: Impact of EM results on batch release:

blocks.zh: EM 行動限超標不自動導致批次拒絕，但 QU 必須進行調查，評估：
blocks.en: An EM action limit excursion does not automatically lead to batch rejection, but the QU must investigate and assess:

blocks.zh: 超標是否發生在灌裝關鍵操作期間（vs 清潔/維護期間）？
blocks.en: Did the excursion occur during critical filling operations (vs. during cleaning/maintenance)?

blocks.zh: 分離出的微生物種類（機會性病原體 vs 環境常見菌）？
blocks.en: What type of microorganism was isolated (opportunistic pathogen vs. common environmental flora)?

blocks.zh: 位置是否在靠近暴露產品或容器的關鍵區域？
blocks.en: Is the location in a critical area close to exposed product or containers?

blocks.zh: 同批次或相關批次的無菌檢測結果？
blocks.en: What are the sterility test results of the same batch or related batches?

blocks.zh: 法規交叉參照 Cross-Reference Map
blocks.en: Cross-Reference Map

blocks.zh: §211.113(b) ↔ FDA 無菌加工指南（2004）：§211.113 是法規義務，指南提供實施細節（培養基灌充、EM 設計、廠房要求）
blocks.en: §211.113(b) ↔ FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004): §211.113 is the regulatory obligation, while the guidance provides implementation details (media fill, EM design, facility requirements)

blocks.zh: §211.94 ↔ USP <1207> / <660>：容器合規測試方法的法典標準
blocks.en: §211.94 ↔ USP <1207> / <660>: compendial standards for container compliance test methods

blocks.zh: §211.113(b) ↔ PIC/S Annex 1（2022）/ EU Annex 1：最新全球無菌製造標準對 §211.113 義務的詳細詮釋
blocks.en: §211.113(b) ↔ PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) / EU Annex 1: the latest global sterile manufacturing standard, giving a detailed interpretation of the §211.113 obligation

blocks.zh: §211.100 ↔ ICH Q10：ICH Q10 第 3.2 節（偏差管理）為 §211.100 書面程序義務提供藥品品質體系框架
blocks.en: §211.100 ↔ ICH Q10: Section 3.2 of ICH Q10 (deviation management) provides the pharmaceutical quality system framework for the written procedure obligation of §211.100

blocks.zh: §211.84(c)(2) ↔ ICH Q7 §7.3：API 製造的物料管控要求，與 §211.84 CoA 依賴條件相互對應
blocks.en: §211.84(c)(2) ↔ ICH Q7 §7.3: material control requirements for API manufacturing, corresponding to the CoA reliance conditions of §211.84

blocks.zh: §211.103 ↔ 21 CFR §211.188：§211.103 要求計算產率，§211.188 要求批次記錄包含實際產率記錄——兩條款協同確保批次完整性
blocks.en: §211.103 ↔ 21 CFR §211.188: §211.103 requires yield calculation, and §211.188 requires batch records to include the actual yield, so the two provisions work together to ensure batch integrity
